summary: Iter 42 verified end-to-end. Generic partner prospects + Explore-before-Embrace flow works across all 6 partner types (facilitator, community, research, vendor, artist, steward). 20/20 backend pytest tests pass; public preview-specs endpoints respond 200 via public URL for all types; admin endpoints correctly reject anonymous (401); UI pages /partner/types, /partner/types/{type}/try, /partner/invite/{token}, /admin/partners/prospects, /admin/gallery/prospects all render. Preview-mode-banner present on every sandbox + invite page. Invite preview renders subscription tier picker (3 tiers w/ MOST CHOSEN ribbon), 'What enrolling means' card with YOU AGREE TO + YOU KEEP + foundation share, and Accept/Decline buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_prospects.py is ~880 lines — borderline for the 700-line guideline; consider splitting PREVIEW_SPECS into a separate module/json for easier per-type tuning without touching route handlers.

auth_token is created via create_token in Accept flow but failure is silently swallowed (except Exception: token_jwt = None). If JWT creation ever fails, the user can't auto-login and there's no log. Recommend logging the exception.

Email send_email failure is also swallowed silently (logger.warning); fine for dry-run, but in production a real failure should bubble back to admin as an actionable response field rather than appearing 'sent'.
PROSPECT_CHANNELS constant is declared but unused (Literal types are repeated inline in ProspectCreate/Interaction). Minor DRY cleanup.
The display_name -> first/last split (`(display_name.split(' ', 1) + [''])[:2]`) is fragile for single-word names (last_name='') and mononyms; acceptable now but worth a note for i18n.
test_credentials: admin@birthright.org / birthright2026 — works for /api/auth/login and admin endpoints. Note: admin user has an 'Updated agreement requires acceptance' banner inside the in-browser session, but this does NOT affect the partner-prospects endpoints under test.
seed_data_creation: Temporary prospect 'UI E2E Test' (facilitator) was created, promoted, previewed, declined and deleted as part of UI verification. No persistent test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Routes /partner/types/{type}/try and /partner/invite/{token} are PUBLIC (no auth). Admin tracker is at /admin/partners/prospects (new) while the artist-only legacy tracker still lives at /admin/gallery/prospects with refined testids (prospect-card, promote-prospect-btn-{id}, log-interaction-btn-{id}, sanity-check-link-{id}). The latter buttons only appear after expanding the card / providing interaction notes — they are NOT rendered as 0-state buttons. Two separate Mongo collections: featured_artist_invites (gallery) vs partner_invites (generic). Both are healthy. Email delivery is dry-run (queues to db.outbound_emails).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All 14 requested behaviors validated.
